knownGaps: OpenAIAccountBridge exposes no child transcript read RPC (wired methods are account/*, thread/start|resume|compact/start, turn/start|interrupt, collaborationMode/list only).
Collab item handlers emit lifecycle then return; they never attach child message/tool/reasoning text to the collaboration event.
Root turn scope ignores notifications whose threadId is not the bridge root thread, so receiver-thread streams would not enter the parent turn handler even if upstream emitted them.
Bridge config forces history.persistence=none; there is no durable child history replay surface.
No node-scoped cancellation control is proven.
Live ChatGPT-account CDP probe of undocumented upstream methods remains optional; ADDOM substance (childStreams) stays false until a real child transcript surface is wrapped and captured.
